lead.description: a chance deviation that scatters from one repeated measurement to the next

self_checks.title: Rod readings
self_checks.prompt: Readings 9.7, 10.2, 9.9 and 10.4 are taken against a 10 cm reference. What are the mean and the sum of squared deviations from the mean?
self_checks.answer: The mean is 10.05 and the sum of squared deviations is 0.29.

self_checks.title: Error of the mean
self_checks.prompt: For those four readings, what is the error of the mean against the reference value 10?
self_checks.answer: The error of the mean is 0.05 cm.

self_checks.title: Centred series
self_checks.prompt: Readings 8, 10 and 12 are taken against a reference of 10. What is the sum of squared deviations from the mean, and the error of the mean?
self_checks.answer: The sum of squared deviations is 8 and the error of the mean is 0.
